design.purpose: Couple BANC structural propagation to the unchanged Phase 4F decoder and compare connectivity-selected upstream stimulation against matched controls.

provenance.source: Phase 4D BANC v888 node table (annotations only)

definitions.LEFT: super_class == 'motor' and side == 'left' and body_part_effector in ['front_leg', 'middle_leg', 'hind_leg'] and not a tergotrochanter candidate
definitions.RIGHT: super_class == 'motor' and side == 'right' and body_part_effector in ['front_leg', 'middle_leg', 'hind_leg'] and not a tergotrochanter candidate
definitions.UNASSIGNED: motor neurons not covered by LEFT, RIGHT or JUMP
definitions.ROLL: unsupported: No published BANC annotation in this export defines a roll motor population; a roll signal would need evidence not present in the structural tables.
definitions.DUCK: unsupported: No published BANC annotation in this export defines a duck or crouch motor population; a duck signal would need evidence not present in the structural tables.

provenance.overlap_policy: tergotrochanter candidates are also leg motor neurons; by default they are removed from LEFT/RIGHT so the action populations are disjoint and JUMP activity is not double-counted

unsupported_actions.ROLL: No published BANC annotation in this export defines a roll motor population; a roll signal would need evidence not present in the structural tables.
unsupported_actions.DUCK: No published BANC annotation in this export defines a duck or crouch motor population; a duck signal would need evidence not present in the structural tables.

provenance.scientific_status: LEFT, RIGHT and JUMP are decoder labels derived from published effector annotations. They are not identified biological motor commands.

candidate_rules.B: Top verified-excitatory descending neurons ranked by total synapses onto motor neurons at threshold 5 (Phase 4E direct descending pathway).
candidate_rules.C: Top verified-excitatory ventral-nerve-cord intrinsic neurons ranked by total direct synapses onto motor neurons at threshold 5 (Phase 4E two-hop intermediate population).
candidate_rules.D: Random verified-excitatory non-motor neurons, matched in size, excluding groups B and C.
candidate_rules.E: Shuffled assignment: random verified-excitatory descending neurons, matched in size, excluding the connectivity-ranked group B.

non_claims: LEFT, RIGHT and JUMP are decoder labels from published annotations, not identified motor commands.
Stimulated neurons are upstream candidates; motor pools are not stimulated.
A decoded action is not evidence of biological motor control.
Structural connectivity and synapse counts are not conductance or physiological connectivity.

D_random_matched.label: D

E_shuffled_assignment.rule: Shuffled assignment: random verified-excitatory descending neurons, matched in size, excluding the connectivity-ranked group B.

seed.note: same run as condition F primary

limitations: Only verified-transmitter neurons can carry current under the primary policy; most BANC neurons and edges are excluded.
Candidate groups are 64 neurons selected by structural ranking, not by any physiological criterion.
The primary weight transform, cap and scale are declared calibrations, not measured conductances.
One graph threshold (5) is primary; threshold 1 and 10 are sensitivity variants only.
Conditions A-E have no stochastic term, so their seed sensitivity is trivially exact; only the noise-only control F varies with seed.
